definitions.explanation: Having qualities that give great pleasure to the senses or mind. A more literary and formal word for beauty compared to きれい.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美|うつく}しい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美|うつく}しい。
{美|うつく}しい⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{静|しず}かに→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent the time quietly while listening to beautiful music.
That painting's colors are so beautiful that they move everyone who sees it.

notes:
{美|うつく}しい is an i-adjective expressing beauty in a more literary and elevated way than ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧.

FORMS:
- Negative: {美|うつく}しくない
- Te-form: {美|うつく}しくて
- Past: {美|うつく}しかった
- Adverbial: {美|うつく}しく
- Noun form: {美|うつく}しさ (beauty)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧: beautiful, pretty, clean (na-adjective; everyday, versatile)
- {美|うつく}しい: beautiful (i-adjective; literary, deeper aesthetic appreciation)
- ⟦{綺麗|きれい}→きれい：00717_kirei⟧ covers both appearance and cleanliness; {美|うつく}しい focuses purely on aesthetic or spiritual beauty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美|うつく}しい⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: beautiful scenery
- {美|うつく}しい⟦{音色|ねいろ}→音色：07422_neiro⟧: beautiful tone
- {美|うつく}しい⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: beautiful words/language

REGISTER:
More formal and literary than ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧. Preferred in writing, poetry, speeches, and when expressing deep admiration.
